statement: The algebraic Hausdorff presentation generated by etale moduli paths, covers, fillings, diagram naturality, and equal-composite relations exists and is equivalent over C to the profinite envelope of the diagram-isotopy category, with exactly the closed-coset Hom spaces of E.6.
depends_on: E.5-E.6; Bertin-Romagny Theorem6.20 and Proposition6.14; Noohi Theorem20.4 and following corollary; Schneps2003 section2.1; density and the Hausdorff universal property
manuscript_passages: MPL142, scans18-21, isotopy and larger category by generators and relations; prompt E3,R25,R26
doubtful_reading: No new reading proposed. The specified isotopy relation is diagram isotopy, not the false two-sided-orbit identification in R26.
notes: Independently reviewed by root. The algebraic presentation expressly uses a closed congruence and Hausdorff targets; no automatic interchange of completion and naive quotient is claimed. Backwards complex structures prove the Betti presentation, and the envelope itself separates all elements outside each stabilizer closure.

statement: The degree-two family f_b(z)=z^2+b, followed by filling the interior branch value b, has diagram stack Y times B(mu_2), right braid stabilizer image(pi1(Y) times C2), and completed stabilizer equal to its closure and to the etale image in the completed source mapping class group.
depends_on: E.5 degree-defect identity; E.8; elementary classification of double covers with two specified branch values; Noohi Theorem20.4
manuscript_passages: MPL142, scans18-21, puncture fillings and isotopy; prompt E3
notes: Independently reviewed by root. Target punctures are labelled and fixed. The defect is completely consumed by the omitted ramification point, forcing the cover-then-fill pattern. No injectivity or subgroup-separability claim for the braid image is assumed.
